semiconductor_relevance: High — Brooks Automation provides critical automation and contamination control solutions that are essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Brooks Automation is a leading provider of semiconductor manufacturing and laboratory automation solutions, specializing in precision vacuum robotics and integrated automation systems. Their products are utilized by major semiconductor chip makers to enhance equipment productivity and availability in fabrication facilities worldwide.
